title: Data, code, and supplemental materials: Effects of Training Duration on Comparisons of Downsampling Operators for Crack Segmentation
description: Supplemental Materials (Tables S1–S8, Figs. S1–S2), validation records of 216 main runs, 66 cosine-schedule runs, and 33 ConvNeXt-UNet runs, core-test confirmation records, preregistration and amendment documents, and analysis scripts accompanying the manuscript 'Effects of Training Duration on Comparisons of Downsampling Operators for Crack Segmentation'. The CRACK500 and DeepCrack537 images are not redistributed.
